monetization.noteEs: Free-to-play desde 2019 con New Light: el core game es gratis pero las expansiones, episodios y dungeon keys se compran aparte. Las microtransacciones son cosméticas (Eververse) o quality-of-life (silver para seasonal pass tiers). Sin ventaja de poder comprable, pero el contenido endgame relevante vive detrás del paywall de la expansión vigente.
monetization.noteEn: Free-to-play since 2019 with New Light: the core game is free but expansions, episodes and dungeon keys are sold separately. Microtransactions are cosmetic (Eververse) or quality-of-life (silver for seasonal pass tiers). No buyable power advantage, but relevant endgame content sits behind the current expansion's paywall.
